title: Atelier
description: atelier.json persisted per game (spec 009 v0.8.0 delta over spec 007 v0.7.0). Changes: players[] gains agentId (archetype legacy-only), new agentSnapshots[] index-aligned with players[] (FR-017), agentConfigs[] deprecated (read-only legacy). All other fields (legs, tours, scores, deck, sets, projectFacts…) unchanged from v0.7.0.

name.description: Joueur-N, N = position after the random launch shuffle (FR-016/FR-020)

archetype.description: Legacy only: readable from pre-009 ateliers (FR-014), never written anymore

agentSnapshots.description: Snapshot of each player's agent config at launch, index-aligned with players[] (FR-017). Never contains the API key value.

apiKeyVar.description: Env var NAME only (empty = no key); key value resolved at runtime via getenv, never persisted (FR-006)

agentConfigs.description: Spec-004 per-player LLM configs (providerType/baseUrl/apiKey/modelName/acpProvider). Readable for legacy ateliers, no longer written. NOTE: legacy files may contain an apiKey value; new code must never write it.

turnOrder.description: Player names in play order; first entry = first leader (random draw at launch, FR-020)
